藏经阁残简 第九章 底蕴骤增同阶无敌（第1页）
彻底吃透《破妄文章》的道韵，沈砚的心境完成质的蜕变，灵台澄澈无垢，修行速度再度暴涨。顶层阁楼堆放着上百卷百年高阶残简，每一卷都蕴藏失传文道法理，他不再耽搁，俯身一卷接一卷修复收录。
《叠文固基诀》能夯实道基，弥补根基损伤；《凝字养神章》滋养神魂，拓宽心神容量；《残风碎叶篆》是上古轻身步法，身法灵动飘逸。一卷卷失传心法、秘术、丹道残篇尽数汇入神魂，化作独属于他的修行底蕴。
宗门弟子修行，依靠的是流传残缺的制式基础功法，上限早早被锁死。而沈砚依托残简道藏，修行完整上古正统文道，两者修行根基云泥之别。源源不断的精纯道韵冲刷经脉，丹田内灵气飞速增长。
凝气五层巅峰、凝气六层初期、凝气六层中期，短短半日，沈砚连跨两层修为。他刻意将所有气息内敛入骨，外表看着依旧清瘦羸弱，内里底蕴却恐怖至极。
寻常修士突破境界只求灵气数量，根基虚浮不堪，稍有大战便灵气紊乱。沈砚每一次突破，都有海量上古道韵打底，神魂浑厚、道基纯粹、经脉无一丝杂质，同阶修士在他面前毫无一战之力。
就算是如今凝气七层的陆明远，真刀真枪和他交手，也会被沈砚厚重的文道真意全面碾压。更令沈砚欣喜的是，他破碎三年的先天道基，如今已经愈合八成，遍布道基的蛛网裂痕尽数收拢，黯淡无光的道基重新焕发出温润光泽。
只差最后一丝滋养，道基便能彻底复原，甚至依托海量上古文脉滋养，品质超越三年前巅峰时期。
沈砚移步阁楼窗边，抬眼望向青云仙宗主峰，仙雾缭绕，殿宇连绵，在外门、内门弟子眼中是人人向往的修行圣地。可在《破妄文章》的透视之下，主峰长老殿、藏经楼的阴影角落，处处缠绕着淡淡的域外黑气，气息隐晦，常人完全无法察觉。
“原来宗门内部早已被邪魔渗透。”沈砚眸光沉静，心中了然近些年来宗门的乱象。天才弟子逐年减少，传承道经残缺不全，门下弟子心境浮躁、修行寸步难行，根源便是这些潜藏在宗门之内的域外黑气，潜移默化腐蚀修士心神、消磨文道气韵。
整片玄洲的修士都深陷其中，浑然不觉大祸将至，唯有拥有残简道藏与破妄文章的他，能够看穿这层虚妄，窥见潜藏的黑暗危机。
沈砚望着远处连绵山峰，轻声自语：“既然如此，我便从这座藏书阁起步，修复一卷卷残简复兴失落文脉，一步一步肃清潜藏的域外黑暗。”
话音落下，他运转功法，将自身修为、绝学道韵全部收敛藏于体内。身上那件洗得发白的灰布杂役长袍，依旧衬得他平凡沉默，任谁路过，都只会把他当成任人欺凌的底层杂役，没有人能想到，这个尘埃里的少年，手握上古神魂绝学，胸中容纳万古文脉，一双慧眼勘破世间所有虚假。
日头攀升至中天，阁楼内百年积攒的灰尘已经被清扫干净，上百卷高阶残简全部被他暗中修复、收录道韵，没有一卷遗漏。刘松本想借清扫阁楼的苦役羞辱折磨他，谁也不曾料到，这场看似屈辱的惩罚，反倒成了沈砚出世以来最大的机缘。

The Fragments of the Sutra Pavilion Chapter 9: The foundation suddenly increases and is invincible at the same level (page 1)
After thoroughly comprehending the Taoist rhyme of "Peilian Articles", Shen Yan's state of mind underwent a qualitative transformation, his spiritual platform became clear and stain-free, and his cultivation speed skyrocketed again. On the top floor of the attic were stacked hundreds of volumes of ancient high-level fragments. Each volume contained lost literary and legal principles. Without any further delay, he repaired and included each volume one by one.
"Lai Wen Guo Ji Jue" can consolidate the Taoist foundation and make up for the damage to the foundation; "Condensing Words and Nourishing the Spirit Chapter" nourishes the soul and expands the capacity of the mind; Volumes of lost mental techniques, secret techniques, and fragments of alchemy were all merged into his soul, turning into his unique cultivation foundation.
The disciples of the sect rely on the standard basic exercises that are passed down and incomplete, and the upper limit has been locked long ago. However, Shen Yan relied on the Taoist Canon of Broken Slips to practice the complete ancient orthodox literature and Taoism. The foundation of their practice was completely different. A steady stream of pure Taoist charm washes through the meridians, and the spiritual energy in the Dantian grows rapidly.
In just half a day, Shen Yan reached the peak of the fifth level of Qi Condensation, the early stage of the sixth level of Qi Condensation, and the middle stage of the sixth level of Qi Condensation. He deliberately restrained all his aura into his bones. He still looked thin and frail on the outside, but he was extremely terrifying on the inside.
Ordinary monks only seek the amount of spiritual energy to break through the realm, but their foundation is frivolous. If there is a slight battle, the spiritual energy will be disordered. Every breakthrough made by Shen Yan was based on a vast amount of ancient Taoism. His soul was thick, his Tao foundation was pure, and his meridians were free of any impurities. Monks of the same level had no power to fight against him.
Even if Lu Mingyuan, who is now at the seventh level of Qi Condensation, fights with him with real swords and guns, he will be completely crushed by Shen Yan's profound literary truth. What makes Shen Yan even more delighted is that his innate Dao foundation, which has been broken for three years, has now healed 80%. All the cobweb cracks all over the Dao foundation have been closed up, and the dull Dao foundation has regained its warm luster.
With only the last trace of nourishment, Daoji can be completely restored, and even relying on the nourishment of massive ancient cultural context, the quality will surpass its peak three years ago.
Shen Yan moved to the attic window and looked up at the main peak of the Qingyun Immortal Sect. The fairy mist was shrouded and the palaces were continuous. In the eyes of the outer and inner sect disciples, it was the holy land of cultivation that everyone yearned for. However, under the perspective of "Polu Article", the shadowed corners of the main peak Elder Hall and Sutra Collection Building are surrounded by a faint black air from outside the territory. The aura is so obscure that ordinary people cannot detect it at all.
"It turns out that the sect has been infiltrated by evil spirits for a long time." Shen Yan's eyes were calm, and he understood the chaos in the sect in recent years. The number of talented disciples is decreasing year by year, the inherited Taoist scriptures are incomplete, and the disciples are restless and have difficulty in practicing. The root cause is the black energy from outside the sect hidden in the sect, which subtly corrodes the minds of the monks and kills the charm of literature and Taoism.
The monks in the entire Xuanzhou were trapped in it, unaware that the catastrophe was coming. Only he, who had the Taoist treasures on the broken bamboo slips and the article on breaking the illusion, could see through this layer of illusion and glimpse the hidden dark crisis.
Shen Yan looked at the distant mountain peaks and whispered to himself: "In this case, I will start from this library, restore the lost scrolls and restore the lost context, and eliminate the hidden darkness outside the territory step by step."
As soon as he finished speaking, he started to use his skills to collect and hide all his cultivation and unique skills in his body. The washed-white gray cloth handyman robe on his body still made him ordinary and silent. Anyone passing by would only think of him as a low-level handyman who was bullied. No one could have imagined that this young man in the dust had the secret knowledge of ancient souls in his hands, his chest contained eternal cultural context, and his pair of insightful eyes could detect all the falsehoods in the world.
The sun climbed to high in the sky, and the dust accumulated in the attic for a hundred years has been cleared away. Hundreds of high-level fragments have all been repaired and collected by him secretly.Recording Taoist rhyme, not a single volume is missing. Liu Song originally wanted to use the hard labor of cleaning the attic to humiliate and torture him, but no one expected that this seemingly humiliating punishment would turn out to be the biggest opportunity since Shen Yan was born.
